# AAC (aac)

AAC through DEE's AAC encoder, written as `.aac`. The output is always 2.0.
Every option is on [deezy encode aac](../cli/encode-aac.md).

```bash
deezy encode aac movie.mkv
deezy encode aac --aac-profile heaac --bitrate 48 movie.mkv
```

`--aac-profile` picks AAC-LC (`aaclc`, the default), HE-AAC (`heaac`) or HE-AAC
v2 (`heaacv2`).

## Data rates

<!-- BEGIN generated by scripts/cli_docs.py from 'deezy bitrates': edit deezy/dee/spec.py, not this block -->

```text {.scrollable-code-block}
aac --aac-profile aaclc (default)
  2.0   default 192: 56-576
aac --aac-profile heaac
  2.0   default 64: 16-143
aac --aac-profile heaacv2
  2.0   default 56: 14-63
```

<!-- END generated -->

DEE's AAC delay depends on the rate; DeeZy compensates it for each one.

## Loudness

AAC carries no loudness metadata, and DEE's AAC encoder can't only measure, so
by default DeeZy leaves the loudness as it is.

- `--loudness-target` (with `--peak-limit`) corrects the audio to that loudness,
  as for [Dolby Digital](dd.md#loudness).
- `--loudness-preset` corrects it to that regulation. It can't be combined with
  `--loudness-target`.
